_comment: Mods that ship with TMNT Story Mode on top of the turtlepower jar. All from Modrinth, Forge 1.20.1.
Run  python3 installer/resolve_mods.py  to turn this into mods.lock.json (exact files, URLs, hashes).
Required dependencies (GeckoLib, YACL, Searchables, CreativeCore...) are pulled in automatically.
World-gen and big content mods (Terralith, Biomes O' Plenty, Create, Cobblemon) are left out on
purpose: they would change the New York world and the story. Keep this list client-friendly.

mods.why: Verity - the AI helper friend that turns into a horror. Voice built in (talk with V).
Config library Verity needs (not listed on Modrinth, but required in its mods.toml).
Proximity voice chat for playing with friends.
Echoes in the sewers. Realistic sound + voice chat reverb.
Shaders support on top of Embeddium (optional, no shaderpack by default).
Don't render mobs you can't see.
Saves the GPU when the game is in the background.
Just Enough Items - recipes for everything, including TMNT items.
Search key binds (lots of mods = lots of keys).
Ambient sounds for the city and sewers.
